content.title: Reality Star Taylor Frankie Paul Is a Mom of 3
content.text: When Taylor Frankie Paul of Hulu's "The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives" was cast as "The Bachelorette," she was considering which of the contestants she likes the most — but also weighing which of the men could make the best father for her children.Unfortunately, her season of the show will not be televised.Paul’s drama started before the new season aired. After a video of Paul throwing furniture near her children surfaced on March 19, ABC decided not to release the show.A Disney Entertainment Television spokesperson said on March 19, “In light of the newly released video just surfaced today, we have made the decision to not move forward with the new season of ‘The Bachelorette’ at this time, and our focus is on supporting the family.”The reality star and her ex, Dakota Mortensen, are currently part of an “ongoing investigation,” three sources close to the matter told NBC News March 17. Filming for Season 5 of “The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives” has also been halted amid the investigation.Paul, one of the original #MomTok creators, is the mom of three. She shares two children, Indy, 8, and Ocean, 5, with her ex-husband, Tate Paul, and her 2-year-old son, Ever, with her ex-boyfriend, Dakota Mortensen.Paul is no stranger to negative publicity. She was one of the main players in the 2022 Mormon "soft swinging" scandal and she was arrested in February 2024 on charges that include assault and committing domestic violence in the presence of a child. The arrest was captured on film and included in Season 1 of "Secret Lives."She pleaded guilty to one charge and four others were dropped.Before the season aired, Paul told TODAY.com that she was not looking forward to seeing that night replayed on screen."I forgot the cameras were there and Dakota and I got into a fight," she said. "My true emotions come out and I think I got a little angry ... I think that’s the first time I share what’s going on in my head. Not that I regret doing that. I opened up to be honest about what was going on. Maybe I regret how I said it."Taylor Frankie Paul's Children With Ex-Husband Tate PaulIndy May Paul, born Aug. 31, 2017The Pauls welcomed their first child, Indy May Paul, on Aug. 31, 2017. "She is perfection and we are so obsessed with our baby girl. 💗 We are so blessed," she wrote on Instagram at the time.It seems that Indy has inherited many of her mom's traits.On a video of Indy and Paul assembling class valentines in February, Paul wrote, "She had to pick the most tedious valentines. She's definitely my child."Paul added in the caption, "One of the best things about parenthood is we get to relive the same excitement we once had through them."Ocean Paul, born June 18, 2020Paul's first son, Ocean, was born on June 18, 2020. In his TikTok intro to the world, Paul wrote that he arrived "with lots of hair and a sweet soul." On Aug. 10, Paul shared a video of Ocean working on a LEGO project. "My least favorite thing to do is Legos, however one of my favorite things is to be with him," she captioned the reel.It looks like Paul had a blast preparing for Ocean's 5th birthday just a few days later. "Planning my kids' birthdays brings me such joy," she wrote on an Instagram video of her stuffing goody bags and arranging balloons.Taylor Frankie Paul’s Child With Ex-Boyfriend Dakota MortensenEver True Mortensen, born Mar. 19, 2024Paul and Mortensen first had an ectopic pregnancy and then conceived son Ever soon after. She announced his birth on Instagram by writing, "Thank you for blending our family."Paul has been taking her social media followers along as Ever hits all of his milestones, including his first haircut.Ever had a fish-themed 1st birthday party in March 2025. To celebrate, Paul wrote on Instagram, "He is the sweetest soul and loves love. Needy like his daddy and stubborn like his mommy. Just as hyper as his sister and brother. Couldn’t be more loved by his village he has beside him."
